text: Final categorization: **OK** (Justification: The paper presents an original, non-review research study that explicitly implements a national-scale (China) spatiotemporal land use change simulation model. It integrates socioeconomic and ecological processes to generate quantitative, spatially explicit LULC projections for 2020, 2050, and 2080 under two distinct yield-change scenarios (A and B). The work includes model validation with quantitative accuracy assessment, reports land use conversion rates and matrices, and compares scenario outcomes both quantitatively and spatially. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction/scenario simulation, implementation of ≥2 future scenarios with comparison, and use of spatial modeling with quantitative metrics. It does not meet any exclusion criteria.)
